Here's the edited script that will move files from your Music folder to iCloud without including "SAMPLE LIBRARY" in the destination path:

```bash:/Users/hack/myscripts/move-to-icloud.sh
# This script moves files to iCloud Drive and creates symlinks at the original locations
# It preserves the folder structure after the specified source directory

# Set to 1 for dry run, 0 for actual execution
DRY_RUN=1
MAX_FILES_PER_FOLDER=5

echo "Script started with argument: $1"
if [ ! -d "$1" ]; then
  echo "‼️ ERROR: Directory '$1' does not exist."
  exit 1
fi

# Function to process files
process_files() {
    local source_dir="$1"
    local count=0
    local current_dir=""
    
    echo "Looking for files in: $source_dir"
    find "$source_dir" -type f | while read -r file; do
        # Extract the part of the path we want to preserve
        # This will get just the path AFTER "lalala.ai splits" 
        rel_path=$(echo "$file" | sed -E "s|.*/lalala\.ai splits/(.*)|\1|")
        folder_path=$(dirname "$rel_path")
        
        # Reset counter when directory changes
        if [ "$folder_path" != "$current_dir" ]; then
            current_dir="$folder_path"
            count=0
            echo -e "\n=== Processing folder: $folder_path ==="
        fi
        
        # Only process MAX_FILES_PER_FOLDER files per folder in dry run
        if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ] && [ $count -ge $MAX_FILES_PER_FOLDER ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Get the parent directory of the current file
        rel_parent_dir=$(dirname "$rel_path")
        
        # Create paths for the iCloud destination
        icloud_dir="/Users/hack/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Music/lalala.ai splits/$rel_parent_dir"
        icloud_file="/Users/hack/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Music/lalala.ai splits/$rel_path"
        
        if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "Would move: $file"
            echo "      to: $icloud_file"
            echo "Symlink would be created at: $file"
            echo "Symlink would point to: $icloud_file"
            echo "---"
            count=$((count + 1))
        else
            # Create the target directory in iCloud
            mkdir -p "$icloud_dir"
            
            # Move the file to iCloud and create a symlink
            mv "$file" "$icloud_file" && ln -s "$icloud_file" "$file" && echo "Moved and linked: $rel_path"
        fi
    done
}

# Main execution
if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE: No files will be moved ==="
    echo "Showing first $MAX_FILES_PER_FOLDER files per folder that would be processed"
else
    echo "=== LIVE MODE: Files will be moved and symlinks created ==="
fi

# Pass the path to the folder you want to process as an argument
process_files "$1"

if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
    echo -e "\n=== End of dry run ==="
    echo "To perform the actual move, set DRY_RUN=0 at the top of the script"
fi
```

The key changes:

1. I modified how the relative path is extracted using `sed` to specifically get everything after "lalala.ai splits/"
2. I updated the iCloud destination paths to include "lalala.ai splits/" explicitly
3. I improved argument quoting to handle paths with spaces better
4. I simplified some of the comments for clarity

Now when you run:
```bash
./move-to-icloud.sh "/Users/hack/Music/SAMPLE LIBRARY/lalala.ai splits"
```

Your sample file will be moved to:
```
/Users/hack/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Music/lalala.ai splits/_DRUMS/The Flying Lizards - Money (Thats What I Want) 1979_drum - 4A - 130.aiff
```
